episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada begrudgingly travels to Ayvalık with Leyla and Sevgi, who seeks alternative treatment. Ada runs into an unexpected figure, and old wounds soon reopen.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Guiding her through a tragedy in her great-grandmother's life, Zaman helps Leyla face her fear of drowning. In Istanbul, Ada's life turns upside down.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Amid an argument, Leyla urges Ada to accept the truth about her marriage to Selim. Ada's vision reveals an atrocity inflicted on someone in her family.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Leyla needs a large sum of money for Erdem's escape. Zaman sheds light on Selim's emotional trauma, which arises from a devastating event during childhood.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Leyla celebrates her windfall but soon faces an ultimatum. During Zaman's session, Toprak reflects on a misfortune that befell his grandfather.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada connects with Belgin and seeks to heal from the wound that pervades her matrilineal ancestry. Sparks fly between Sevgi and Fiko.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada discovers her father's secret. Selim faces a dilemma that would jeopardize his chances with Ada. Tensions come to a head between Sevgi and her mom.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: On her wedding night, Sevgi reads an earth-shattering letter from Muko. Leyla makes Fiko a business proposal. Ada and Toprak reach a crossroads.

episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada and Toprak face growing trust issues, while Sevgi pushes Fiko away. Leyla's pregnancy news sparks a jailhouse confrontation with Erdem.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Leyla gives birth to a baby girl, upending her world. Ada grapples with unresolved grief and a fresh start. Sevgi shares a devastating revelation.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada confronts skepticism from fellow doctors. Tensions flare as unexpected visitors disrupt Leyla's peace, while Sevgi awaits critical health news.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Sevgi starts anew and mends things with Fiko, while Ada is given an ultimatum at the hospital. Leyla has an emotional breakthrough with her mother.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada deepens her holistic studies with Diyar's help, sparking a new romance. Sevgi shares her secret with Fiko as they think of their future together.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada's relationship with Diyar complicates her life as she tries to navigate new personal and professional dilemmas.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Ada navigates past and present loves. Leyla and Fiko tackle a last-minute crisis before their big opening, while Sevgi's secret weighs heavily.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Sevgi's health struggles come to light. Meanwhile, Leyla and Fiko find hope in a rare discovery. Ada turns the page on Ayvalik for a new chapter.

episodes.title: 1. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Sparks fly on Ada's flight back from Spain, while Leyla's love life fizzles to a stop. Sevgi gets a call from social services with good news.

episodes.title: 2. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Family relations become complicated when Fiko's father shows up unannounced. Ada and Deniz finally come face to face all these years later.

episodes.title: 3. Bölüm
episodes.summary: With a tumultuous welcome party, Deniz has trouble connecting with both Ada and her best friends. Sevgi's troubled father-in-law goes missing.

episodes.title: 4. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Deniz proves to be more trouble than expected — and while Özgür insists that her misdeeds might be a cry for help, Ada feels more helpless than ever.

episodes.title: 5. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Leyla suffers a panic attack when she is faced with a painful memory. Suppressed stress resurfaces when Ada begins to question Özgür's intentions.

episodes.title: 6. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Eleni's Tavern suffers a heinous crime and the three friends are forced to come together to rise above the heartbreak and the ashes of their past.

episodes.title: 7. Bölüm
episodes.summary: Breaking through her own barriers, Ada tries to show up for Deniz despite their complicated history. Sevgi introduces Halime to her new home and family.

episodes.title: 8. Bölüm
episodes.summary: As Ada's clinic continues to grow, we learn how Sevgi's fight for justice was shaped by her childhood. A heartbroken Leyla chooses to put family first.
